### What Joseph Knew
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/what-joseph-knew-greg-laurie-devotion-march-20-2021.html
Passage: Genesis 45:5
Points:
- Joseph chose radical forgiveness over the opportunity for revenge.
- He recognized that God remained in complete control throughout his hardships.
- God orchestrated Joseph's circumstances to preserve lives during the severe famine.
- Believers can take comfort knowing God sovereignly directs every season of life.

### The Memory Of Past Sins
Author: Dennis J. DeHaan
Site: Our Daily Bread
URL: https://military.odb.org/the-memory-of-past-sins/
Passage: Genesis 45:5
Points:
- Joseph immediately reassured his terrified brothers to stop self-condemnation from taking root.
- Persistent self-blame after repenting keeps the painful memory of sin alive.
- Jesus bore our transgressions on the cross so we do not have to carry ongoing guilt.
- True peace comes from focusing on Christ's forgiveness rather than past failures.
